remaining_limitations: Some S3 authentication/quota HTTP403 responses are conservatively reported as STORAGE_TIMEOUT with retryability and outcome_ambiguous because restic omits explicit provider codes.
Credential orphan recovery requires Linux process visibility and fails closed when uncertain.
Google natural seven-day Testing-grant expiry and real Google quota exhaustion were not exercised; actual revocation/invalid-grant recovery passed.
Source capacity fault drills use a systemd substitute; watchdog/reboot guarantees have separate real systemd VM evidence.
Authenticated recovery proof covers one dedicated synthetic LOCAL item/attachment and the pinned official CLI; older Drive/VM application reports retain their structural-only scopes.

acceptance.scope: Passing judgments apply to the recorded synthetic/disposable preservation and workflow boundaries, not unconditional whole-spec or production readiness.
acceptance.AC26: passed recorded preservation fault categories; precise quota diagnosis remains limited
